notes.title: The Arcane Tower area, the Knight unit, and the Protection spell!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Fight Lanceblade, the Knight boss of the Arcane Tower area! After defeating the boss, you'll get a new unit, the Knight, and a new spell, Protection![/b][/h3]

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New area with five new levels to play!
[*] New spell: Protection - Protects all friendly units within range. The protection shield dome lasts five turns. Enemy hits can weaken it.
[*] New unit: Knight - a strong melee unit that, when attacking, pushes the enemy back one square. 
[*] New Square: Spikes - Deadly Square. If a unit falls into this square, it dies!
[*] New tutorials showing the new elements: Protection spell / Knight unit / Spikes square.
[*] Added three levels of Arcane Tower to play in local/online matches.
[*] Rule fix: Teleport spell: Now can teleport to any square except adjacent to a boss/wizard (minimum distance from boss reduced to 2).
[*] Rule fix: Summon units: Now a unit can be summoned to any square except adjacent to a boss/wizard (minimum distance from boss reduced to 2).
[*] Bugfix: All bosses now have 15 HP and 4 damage.
[*] Bugfix: Dispel spell now removes all negative effects from the friendly units and all positive effects from the enemies within range.
[*] Minor visual fixes and text corrections.
[*] Memory usage optimization.
[*] Added some sounds fx.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Get involved in the development process![/h3]
We invite you to become an integral part of Slidemagi's development by joining our Discord community or leaving your comments in the discussions area. Your feedback and ideas are eagerly awaited, and we believe they will make a significant difference! :)

notes.title: Update: Area 6 - Frostfire Passage!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Enter Frostfire Passage, a frozen and dangerous area, the domain of Glacius and the Ice Elementals! You must defeat him to gain a new unit, the Ice Elemental, and a new spell, Ice Storm![/b][/h3]

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New area with five new levels to play!
[*] New spell: Ice Storm - Freezes all enemies within range.
[*] New unit: Ice Elemental - A strong melee unit that freezes attacked enemies.!
[*] New Square: Ice - It breaks every turn with a unit on it. When it breaks completely, it turns into water!
[*] New tutorials showing the new elements: Ice Storm spell / Ice Elemental unit / Ice square.
[*] Added three levels of Frostfire Passage to play in local/online matches.
[*] Rule fix: Objects can now be placed on brittle rock and ice.
[*] Rule Fix: The Healer heals trapped units, and if fully healed hits the web.
[*] Units summon sound fx added.
[*] Minor visual fixes and text corrections.
[*] Memory usage optimization.
[*] Added some sounds fx.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[*] Orc spell now cost 30.
[*] Level 1 now has five cards instead of four.
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Area 5 - Black Forest!
notes.content:
[h3][b]You have reached the Black Forest, the domain of Fangrot, the Orc Boss. You must defeat him to gain a new unit, the Orc, and a new spell, Flood![/b][/h3]

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New area with five new levels to play!
[*] New spell: Flood - Flood the squares within range. Instantly drowns non-flying enemies in the area.
[*] New unit: Orc - A strong melee unit that when attacking pushes the enemy back one square!
[*] New tutorials showing the new elements: Flood / Orc.
[*] Added three levels of Black Forest to play in local/online matches.
[*] Changed the order of execution of the actions: Now TNT Dwarfs go after Vikings.
[*] Improved the readability of units trapped in a spider web, and the friendly units breaking the web.
[*] Polished the creation of the spider web, the hits, and its destruction.
[*] Bugfix: Spider web turns now decrease if a friendly unit hits the web.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a bug preventing a unit from appearing when summoning.
[*] Bugfix: Fixed a small bug in a tutorial.
[*] Reordering of the cards of the enemy deck (equal units go together).
[*] Dust particles were added to the levels.
[*] Minor visual fixes and text corrections.
[*] Added some sounds fx.
[*] Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Second Update - Balance and bug fixes
notes.content:
[h3]Update Highlights: [/h3]
[list]
[*] First levels are now easier.
[*] The actions have been accelerated, so as not to wait so long when there are many.
[*] The starting hand has at least three units. When a card is used, a random one from the deck is dealt.
[*] Introduced a "Sudden Death" rule! If after ten moves, each player has only one remaining unit on the board and no cards on deck, one energy point will be drained for every next move!
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when the bee killed a bomb dwarf.
[*] Minor bugs and text fixes.
[*] We added some testers to the credits who have made contributions to the game.
[/list]

[h3]Get involved in the development process![/h3]

notes.title: First update! - More languages and bug fixes
notes.content:
[h3]New features[/h3]
We added support for Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese, which at launch had a bug that forced us to disable them.

[h3]Bug fixed[/h3]
We fixed an issue that caused the CPU to "think" about each movement for a long time, this was even more noticeable on computers with little memory.

We also fixed some minor bugs.
